(--m.) a dunce, dull-headed man, blockhead; ग्रंथानधीत्य व्याकर्तुमिति दुर्मेधसोऽप्यलं Śi. 2. 26. --यशस् n. ill-repute, dishonour. --योगः {1} a bad or clumsy contrivance. {2} a bad combination. --योध, --योधन a. invincible, unconquerable. --(नः) the eldest of the 101 sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Gāndhārī [From his early years he conceived a deep hatred for his cousins the Pāṇḍavas, but particularly Bhīma, and made every effort he could to compass their destruction. When his father proposed to make Yudhiṣṭhira heirapparent, Duryodhana did not like the idea, as his father was the reigning sovereign, and prevailed upon his blind father to send the Pāṇḍavas away into exile. Vāraṇāvata was fixed upon as their abode, and under pretext of constructing a palatial building for their residence, Duryodhana caused a palace to be built mostly of lac, resin and other combustible materials, thereby hoping to see them all destroyed when they should enter it. But the Pāṇḍavas were forewarned and they safely escaped. They then lived at Indraprastha, and Yudhiṣṭhira performed the Rājasūya sacrifice with great pomp and splendour. This event further excited the anger and jealousy of Duryodhana who was already vexed to find that his plot for burning them up had signally failed, and he induced his father to invite the Pāṇḍavas to Hastināpura to play with dice (of which Yudhiṣṭhira was particularly fond). In that gambling-match, Duryodhana, who was ably assisted by his maternal uncle Śakuni, won from Yudhiṣṭhira everything that he staked, till the infatuated gambler staked himself, his brothers, and Draupadī herself, all of whom shared the same fate. Yudhiṣṭhira, as a condition of the wager, was forced to go to the forest with his wife and brothers, and to remain there for twelve years and to pass one additional year incognito. But even this period, long as it was, expired, and after their return from exile both the Pāṇḍavas and Kauravas made great preparations for the inevitable struggle and the great Bhāratī war commenced. It lasted for eighteen days during which all the Kauravas, with most of their allies, were slain. It was on the last day of the war that Bhīma fought a duel with Duryodhana and smashed his thigh with his club.]. --योनि a. of a low birth. --लक्ष्य a. difficult to be seen or perceived, hardly visible. --लभ a. {1} difficult to be attained, or accomplished; R. 1. 67, 17. 70; Ku. 4. 40, 5. 46, 61. {2} difficult to be found or met with, scarce, rare; शुद्धांतदुर्लभं Ś. 1. 16. {3} best, excellent, eminent. {4} dear, beloved. {5} costly. --ललित a. {1} spoilt by fondling, fondled too much, hard to please; हा मदंकदुर्ललित Ve. 4; V. 2. 8; Māl. 9. {2} (hence) wayward, naughty, illbred, unruly; स्पृहयामि खलु दुर्ललितायास्मै Ś. 7 --(तं) waywardness, rudeness. --लेख्यं a forged document. --वच a. {1} difficult to be described, indescribable. {2} not to be talked about. {3} speaking improperly, abusing. --(चं) abuse, censure, foul language. --वचस् n. abuse, censure. --वर्ण a. bad-coloured. --(र्णं) {1} silver. {2} a kind of leprosy. --वस a. difficult to be resided in. --वसतिः f. painful residence; R. 8. 94. --वह a. heavy, difficult to be borne; U. 2. 10; Ku. 1. 11. --वाच् a. speaking ill. His anger, like that of Jamadagni, has become almost proverbial). --वाहितं a heavy burden. --विगाह, --विगाह्य a. difficult to be penetrated or fathomed, unfathomable. --विचिंत्य inconceivable, inscrutable --विदग्ध {1} unskilled, raw, foolish, stupid, silly. {2} wholly ignorant. {3} foolishly puffed up, elated, vainly proud; वृथाशस्त्रग्रहणदुर्विदग्ध Ve. 3; ज्ञानलवदुर्विदग्धं ब्रह्मापि नरं न रंजयति Bh. 2. 3. --विद्य a. uneducated. --विध a. {1} mean, base, low. {2} wicked, vile. {3} poor, indigent; विदधाते रुचिगर्वदुर्विधं N. 2. 23. {4} stupid, foolish, silly. --विनयः misconduct, imprudence. --विनीत a. {1} (a) badly educated, ill-mannered, ill-behaved, wicked; शासितरि दुर्विनीतानां Ś. 1. 25. s: klI, (BikzAyA aBAvaH .) BikzAyA aprAptikAlaH । akAla iti BAzA । yaTA, “durBikzamalpaM smaraRaM cirAya .” ityudBawaH ॥ BikzAyAH prAyo nizPalatvamityavyayIBAvasamAsaH । yaddeSe yatkAle taddeSatatkAlayogyaSasyAdikaM na jAyate taddeSe tadA yAcyamAnadravyAlABAt durBikzaM jAtamiti vyavahriyate sadBiriti । tatkArakavarzARi yaTA, -- “rAzwraBaNgaSca durBikzaM taskarErupapIqanam । jAnIyAdbigrahaM GoraM pramATini varAnane ! ॥ 13 ॥ durBikzaM jAyate GoraM sarvvopadravasaMyutam । anAvfzwiH samAKyAtA vyaye saMvatsare priye ! ॥ 20 ॥ kvacidbarzati parjjanyo deSe saMCinnamaRqalaH । durBikzaM sarvvarIvarze vyavahAro viparyyayaH ॥ 34 । durBikzaM jAyate sarvvA medinI duzyati priye ! । plave plavanti toyAni pIqitA mAnavA Buvi ॥ 35 ॥ durBikzaM jAyate GoraM DAnyOzaDiprapIqanam । anale ca samAKyAtA nAtra kAryyAvicAraRA ॥ 50 deSaBaNgaH sudurBikzaM samAsAt kaTayAmyaham । piNgale cArupadmAkzi ! durBikzaM narmmadAtawe ॥ 51 ॥ durBikzaM maDyamaM proktaM vyavahAro na varttate । BavedvE maDyamA vfzwirdurmmatO samupasTite ॥ 55 ॥ durBikzaM maraRaM GoraM DAnyOzaDiprapIqanam । pAparogo Baveddevi ! raktAKye'maravandini ! ॥ 58 ॥ rogo maraRadurBikzaM viroDopadravAkulam । kroDe tu vizamaM sarvvaM samAKyAtaM harapriye ! ॥ 59 ॥ medinI calate devi ! sarvvaBUtaM carAcaram । deSaBaNgaSca durBikzaM kzaye saNkzIyate prajA ॥ sOrAzwre mAlave deSe dakziRe koNkaRe taTA । durBikzaM jAyate GoraM kzaye saMvatsare priye ! ॥” 50 ॥ iti jyotistattvaDftazazwivarzAntargatavarzaviSezaPalaboDakaBavizyapurARIyavacanAni ॥ * ॥ adBute'pi durBikzaM Bavati yaTA, -- “mAMsAsTinI samAdAya SmaSAnAdgfGravAyasAH । SvA SfgAlo'TavA maDye purasya praviSanti cet ॥ vikiranti gfhAdO ca SmaSAnaM sA mahI Bavet । cOreRa hanyate lokaH paracakrasamAgamaH ॥ saMgrAmaSca mahAGoro durBikzaM marakantaTA । adButAni prasUyante tatra deSasya vidravaH ॥ akAle PalapuzpARi deSavidravakAraRam ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ * ॥ “tatrASOciBikzAgrahaRe dozABAva iti hAralatApraBftayaH ॥ kOrmme । sadyaHSOcaM samAKyAtaM durBikze cApyupaplave । qimbAhave hatAnAYca vidyutA pArTivErdbijEH ॥ sadyaHSOcaM samAKyAtaM SApAdimaraRe taTA ॥” iti SudDitattvam ॥ api ca gAruqe 226 aDyAye । “durBikzayuktarAzwre ca mftake sUtake'pi vA । niyamASca na duzyanti dAnaDarmmaratAstaTA ॥ dIkzitAScABiziktASca vratatIrTaparAstaTA । dIkzAkAle vivAhAdO devadroRyAM nimantrite ॥ pUrvvasaNkalpite cApi nASOcaM mftasUtake ॥”
v: avya॰ BikzAyAH aBAvaH । 1 BikzAyA aBAve । durlaBA BikzA yatra prA॰ ba॰ । yaddeSe yAni SasyAni jAyante taddeSe taddravyasyAnutpattyA 2 taddravyAlABasamayaBede na॰ tatsamayaBedasUcakASca zazwisaMvatsarAntargatA varzaBedAH jyoti॰ ta॰ Bavizyapu॰ uktAH saMgfhya darSyante yaTA “rAzwraBaNgaSca durBikzaM taskarErupapIqanam । jAnIyAdvigrahaM GoraM pramATini 13 varAnane! । “durBikzaM jAyate GoraM sarvopadravasaMyutam । anAvfzwiH samAKyAtA vyaye 20 saMvatsare priye!” । “kvacidvarzati parjanyo deSe saMCinnamaRqalaH । durBikzaM sarvarIvarze 34 vyavahAre viparyayaH” । “durBikzaM jAyate sarvA medinI duzyati priye! । plave 35 plavanti toyAni pIqitA mAnavA Buvi” । “durBikzaM jAyate GoraM DAnyOzaDiprapIqanam । anale 50 ca samAKyAtA nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA” । “deSaBaNgaH sudurBikzaM samAsAt kaTayAmyaham । piNgale 51 cAru padmAkzi! durBikzaM narmadAtawe” । “durdikzaM maDyamaM proktaM vyavahAro na vartate । BavedvE maDyamA vfzwirdurmatO 55 samupasTite” । “durBikzaM maraRaM GoraM DAnyOpraDiprapIqanam । pAparogo Baveddevi! raktAkze 58 'maravandani”! । “rogo maraRadurBikzaM viroDopadravAkulam । kroDe 59 tu vizamaM sarvaM samAKyAtaM harapiye!” । 59 “medinI calate devi! sartaBUtaM carAcaram । deSaBaNgaSca durBikza kzaye saMkzoyate prajAH । sOrAzwre mAlave deSe dakziRe koNkaRe taTA । durBikzaM jAyate GoraM kzaye60 saMvatsare priye!” । kvacidadButotpAte'pi durBikzaM Bavati yaTA “mAMsAsTinI samAdAya SmaSAnAd gfDravAyasAH । SvA SfgAlo'Ta vA maDye purasya praviSanti cet । viki ranti gfhAdO ca SmaSAnaM sA mahI Bavet । cOreRa hanyate lokaH paracakrasamAgamaH । sagrAmaSca mahA Goro durBikzaM marakastaTA । adBatAni prasUyante tatra deSasya vidravaH । akAle PalapuzpARi deSavidravakAraRam” iti jyota॰ ta॰ । tatra kAle'SOciByo BikzAgrahaRe dozABAva iti hAralatApraBftayaH । kOrme “sadyaHSOcaM samAKyAtaM durBikze cApyupaplave । qimbAhave hatAnAYca vidyutA pArTivErdvijEH । sadyaH SOcaM samAKyAtaM SApAdimaraRe taTA” iti Su॰ ta॰ “durBikzayuktarAzwre ca mftake sUtake'pi vA । niyamASca na duzyanti dAnaDarmaratezvapi । dIkzitAScABiziktASca vratatIrTaparAstaTA । dIkzAkAle vivAhAdO devadroRyAM nimantrite । pUrvasaNkalpite cApi nASOca mftasUtake” iti gAruqe 226 a॰ “SakawaH SAkinI gAvo jAlamAskandanaM vanam । anUpaH parvato rAjA durBikze nava vfttayaH” cARakyAH “dvAvimO puruzO loke sUryamaRqalaBedinO । dAtAnnasya tu durBikze suBikze vastrahemadaH” । “ekagrAme catuHsAle durBikze rAzwra viplave । patinA nIyamAnAyAH puraHSukro na duzyati” jyo॰ ta॰ ।
m: दुर्—भिक्ष n. (rarely m.) scarcity of provisions, dearth, famine, want, distress, TĀr. i, 4, 3; Mn.; MBh. &c.

zawtriMSanmatezvevam brAhmepi, “SfNgidaMzwrinaKaMvyAlavizavahnikriyAjalEH” । vyAlogajaH । “sudUrAtparihartavyaH kurvan krIqAM mftastu yaH । nAgAnAM vipriyaM kurvan hataScApyaTa vidyutA । nigfhItaH svayaM rAjYA cOryyadOzeRa kutracit । paradArAn harantaSca dvezAttu patiBirhatAH । asamAnESca saNkIrREScaRqAlAdyESca vigraham । kftvA tErnihatAstadvaccaRqAlAdIn samASritAH । SastrAgnigaradAScEva pAKaRqA krUrabudDayaH । kroDAtprAyaM vizaM vahniM SastramudbanDanaM jalam । girivfkzaprapAtaM ca ye kurvanti narADamAH । kuSalyajIvino ye ca sUnAlaNkAraDAriRaH । muKe BagAstu ye kecit klIvaprAyA । etAni patitAnAM tu yaH karoti vimohitaH । taptakfcCradvayenEva tasya SudDirna cAnyaTA” । tatra durmaraRanimittaM dAnAdi tatroktaM yaTA “tatra durmaraRanimittaM dAnAdikAryaM tacca viSvaprakASAdO darSitaM yaTA SAtAtapIye ca “vyAGreRa nihate viprErviprakanyAM vivAhayet । sarpadazwe nAgabalirjYeyaH sapaSca kAYcanaH । caturnizkamitaM hEmaM gajaM dadyAdgajerhate । rAjYA vinihate dadyAt puruzaM tu mfte cEva dvinizkaM svarRajaM harim । saMskArahIne ca mfte kumAramupanAyayet । nizkatrayasvarRamitaM dadyAdaSvaM hayAhate । SunA hate kzetrapAlaM sTApayennijaSaktitaH । sUkareRa hate dadyAnmahizaM dakziRAnvitam । kfmiBiSca mfte dadyAdgoDUmAn paYcaKArikAH । vfkzaM vfkzahate dadyAtsOvarRaM vastrasaMyutam । Sakawena hate dadyAddravyaM sopaskarAnvitam । BfgupAtamfte cEva pradadyAdDAnyaparvatam । agninA nihate kAryamudapAnaM svaSaktitaH । dAruRA nihate cEva kartavyA sadane saBA । SastreRa nihate dadyAnmahizIM dakziRAnvitAm । aSmanA nihate dadyAtsavatsAM gAM payasvinIm । vizeRa ca mfte dadyAnmedinIM hemanirmitAm । udbanDanena ca mfte kapiM kanakanirmitam । mfte jalena varuRaM hEmaM dadyAddvinizkajam । vizUcikAmfte svAdu Bojayecca SataM dvijAn । GftaDenuH pradAtavyA kaRWAnnakabale mfte । kAsarogeRa ca mfte azwakfcCraM vrataM caret । atisAramfte lakzaM gAyatryAH prayato japet । SAkinyAdigrahagraste japedrudaM yaToditam । vidyutpAtena nihate vidyAdAnaM samAcaret । antarikza mfte vidaDyAdOrDvadehikam” । anantaBawwena tu durmaraRaprakArAScatuHzazwi prakArA uktAste ca tatkftAntyezwipadDatO dfSyAH ।

pAyasamicCAmi Boktumityeva satvaraH । tadEva tu mayA tasya cittajYena gfhe janaH । sarvARyannAni pAnAni BakzyAScoccAvacAstaTA । Bavantu satkftAnIha pUrvameva pracoditaH । tado'haM jAyamAnaM vE pAyasa pratyavedayam । taM BuktvEva tu sa kzipraM tato vacanamabravIt । kzipramaNgAni limpasva pAyaseneti sa sma ha । avimfzyEva ca tataH kftavAnasmi tattaTA । tenocCizwena gAtrARi SiraScEvAByamrakzayam । sa dadarSa tadAmyAse mAtarante SuBAnanAm । tAmapi smayamAnaH sa pAyasenAByalepayet । muniH pAyasadigDANgIM raTe tUrRamayojayat । tamAruhya raTaYcEva niryayO ca gfhAnmama । agnivarRojvalan DImAn sa dvijo raTaDUryyavat । pratodenAtudadvAlAM rukmiRIM mama paSyataH । na ca me stokamapyAsIdduHKamIrzyAkftaM tadA । taTA sa rAjamArgeRa mahatA niryayO bahiH । taddfzwvA mahadAScaryaM dASArhA jAtamanyavaH । taTA'jalpan miTaH kecit samABAzya parasparam । vrAhmaRA eva jAyeran nAnyo varRaH kaTaYcana । ko hyenaM raTamAsTAya jIvedanyaH pumAniha । ASIvizavizaM tIkzRaM tatastIkzRataro dvijaH । brahmASIvizadagDasya nAsti kaSciccikitsakaH । tasmin vrajati durdDarze prAsKaladrukmiRI paTi । tatrAmarzayata SrImAMstatastUrRamacodayat । tataH paramasaMkrudDo raTAt praskandya sadvijaH । padAtirutparTenEva prAdravaddakziRAmuKaH । tamutpaTena DAvantamanvaGAvaM dvijottamam । taTEva payasA digDaH prasIda Bagavanniti । tato vilokya tejasvI brAhmaRo mAmuvAca ha । jitaH kroDastvayA kfzRa!
